description: This file defines the EventHubBatchContainer class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for handling batches of EventData in an Orleans streaming context. It manages serialization/deserialization of event payloads, stream identifiers, sequence tokens, and provides methods to extract events and update event data.

classes.name: EventHubBatchContainer
classes.description: A batch container for EventHub events, providing serialization, deserialization, and event extraction functionalities within Orleans streaming.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Internal class representing the payload structure containing events and request context.

methods.name: GetPayload
methods.description: Deserializes and caches the payload from the EventHubMessage.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specific type from the batch.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context into Orleans if present.

methods.name: ToEventData
methods.description: Creates an EventData object from a list of events and request context.

methods.name: UpdateEventData
methods.description: Updates an EventData object with events and request context.

methods.name: CreateEventDataBody
methods.description: Serializes events and request context into a BinaryData payload.
